image_query: Pattachitra painting Odisha Jagannath traditional scroll art
tweets: Pattachitra — Odisha's scroll paintings on cloth stiffened with tamarind-seed paste and chalk, burnished to a leather-like sheen. Colours are earth and shell: conch-white, soot-black, stone ochre, bound in gum, in unbroken lines of Jagannatha's lore.
